clips.title: The story
paras: Thunder Falls is a secluded mountain ravine tucked away in the northwestern heights of Elwynn Forest. Cradled between sheer cliffs and fed by roaring cascades, it features a quiet riverside cottage that has fallen into the hands of local bandits.

Tucked away in the jagged ridges above Mirror Lake, Thunder Falls is an unusual geographical cleft. The ravine is carved by a swift mountain stream that enters via an inaccessible northern cascade, only to drop away on both sides in dramatic waterfalls. One side plunges down into Mirror Lake, while the downstream course flows west toward the rugged borders of Westfall. Despite the roaring waters, a small cottage, a dock, and an outdoor forge sit along the shore, though outlaws now claim the peaceful clearing for themselves.
